rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for pulling something toward oneself.

example.english: Pull the chair over here first.
example.jyutping: nei5 laai1 zoeng1 dang3 maai4 lei4 sin1

rows.note: Use this specifically for picking or plucking fruit, flowers, or similar things.

example.english: These strawberries are ripe, so you can pull them off now.
example.traditional: 呢啲士多啤梨熟喇，可以摘喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 si6 do1 be1 lei4 suk6 laa3 ho2 ji5 zaak6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when removing items from display, circulation, or availability by putting them away.

example.english: This toy is no longer for sale, so pull it from the shelves.
example.traditional: 呢款玩具唔再賣喇，收起晒。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 waan2 geoi6 m4 zoi3 maai6 laa3 sau1 hei2 saai3

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone strains or injures a muscle, tendon, or ligament.

example.english: I managed to pull a thigh muscle while playing soccer.
example.traditional: 我踢波嗰陣拉傷咗大髀。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tek3 bo1 go2 zan6 laai1 soeng1 zo2 daai6 bei2
